item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.6 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.6 Preview
- Settings now uses a compact native layout: **Settings**, **Tools**, and **Legacy Lab** tabs, with the Clean Sweep icon and version in the header. - Brush, filmstrip marker, and update preferences have shorter explanations. **Help** and the marker's **?** button explain the details without losing your changes. Switching tabs also keeps your changes until **Save** or **Cancel**. - Tools have direct buttons. **Add Existing Spot** is the clearer name for Queue Selected Spot; Queue Details and Clear Queue are on the Tools tab. Opening an action closes Settings without saving unfinished preferences, and Clear Queue still asks for confirmation. - The Legacy Lab tab has direct links to the app directory, Patreon, Gainmap, The Epic Workflow, Secondlight, Insight, and LeadLens. - Includes the Mac update-location fix and direct ZIP **Download** button from earlier previews. The complete download contains **CleanSweep.lrplugin**.
Finish or stop your batch and close the status window before replacing your plug-in, then reload it in Plug-in Manager. If your installed folder is still named **RemovalQueue.lrplugin**, follow the migration instructions in the included README, or rename the downloaded folder to match before replacing it in place. Keep the Mac companion inside the complete plug-in folder.
Native Lightroom rendering and interaction with the new tabs remain manual acceptance checks. Saved queues, preferences, processing behavior, and the update connection are unchanged.
